vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-77037
vulnerability.description: multer vulnerable to Denial of Service via file descriptor leak on aborted uploads

statements.impact_statement: Bumped multer ^2.0.2 -> ^2.3.0 in backend/package.json; lockfile resolves to 2.3.0. Advisory fixes the file-descriptor leak on aborted uploads via upstream commit eef7444. Backend lint + typecheck + tests (445) + build all green after the bump.

vulnerability.name: GHSA-2x7j-588g-ccc2
vulnerability.description: Nodemailer: Quadratic (O(n^2)) time complexity in addressparser allows remote DoS via a crafted address list

statements.impact_statement: Bumped nodemailer ^9.0.5 -> ^9.1.1 in backend/package.json; lockfile resolves to 9.1.1, which is at or past the 9.1.0 fix. Addressparser DoS closed by upstream commits 34da642/7cc38af. Backend gates green after the bump.

vulnerability.name: GHSA-8m3c-c648-2xjj
vulnerability.description: Nodemailer: resolveContent() on a MailMessage bypasses disableFileAccess/disableUrlAccess when called with the legacy signature

statements.impact_statement: Bumped nodemailer ^9.0.5 -> ^9.1.1 in backend/package.json; lockfile resolves to 9.1.1, containing the 9.1.1 fix. Legacy resolveContent() bypass closed by upstream commits ab7ef34/dc48ed3. Backend gates green after the bump.
